gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a positive prior accident year development of $63.2m in 2022 (a release), equivalent to roughly a 3.3% release of opening gross claims outstanding. Management attributes the improvement primarily to releases related to 2017-2020 weather-related large loss events (notably within Property) and favourable attritional experience in certain Property and Casualty classes. Current-year large weather events (most significantly Hurricane Ian) impacted 2022 results but prior-year reserve releases drove the positive prior accident year development.
